summary: The Greenbrier Companies filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Sixth Amendment to its Fourth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement and a Third Amendment to the Amended and Restated Credit Agreement of its subsidiary, GLC. The amendments remove the SOFR adjustment (Sixth Amendment) and refinance existing term loans into a $300 million Amended Term Loan plus a new $125 million Delayed Draw Term Loan facility with a six-month availability period; both mature May 5, 2032. Proceeds support general corporate purposes and leasing fleet expansion. This is a non-transformational financing transaction, not a special situation.
